title: The Euro's losing streak runs on as the Fed matches the ECB's rate hike
summary: The European Central Bank (ECB) raised its deposit rate to 2.50% on September 10, and the Euro has fallen every session since. The Fed raised its own rate to 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday, by the same quarter point, and the day's drop was the biggest of the run.

title: Oil Above $100 Pushes U.S. Fuel Prices to New Records
summary: Oil markets appear to have reached the inflection point that many analysts had predicted weeks ago as the Middle East conflict re-escalated with no diplomatic push in sight and global inventories continue to slump. Oil prices are back above $100 per barrel, lifting diesel and gasoline prices, including in the United States. The Trump Administration is looking to downplay the price spikes it sees as only temporary. title: Shale Oil Now Makes Up 72% of Argentina's Crude Output, Data Shows
summary: Argentina's controversial right-wing president, Javier Milei, slashed inflation with a brutal dose of economic austerity, but this came at a steep social cost. The cost of living is spiraling higher, fueling household debt, loan delinquencies, and economic hardship. Industrial output, since Milei took office, has declined sharply, with local companies closing at an alarming rate.
